title: git_clone_repo asks every time on a card naming the connection and git

clauses.text: git_clone_repo asks every time on a card naming the connection and git_clones_list is read only

steps.do: Ask the assistant to clone a repository, then to list the clones.
steps.expect: The clone asks on a card that names the connection and its method but never a token, also in Auto mode; the list does not ask.
